name: qr-cow-mcp
description: Create, style, and manage QR codes (with scan analytics) from any MCP client.
long_description: MCP server for qr-cow.com. Tools: create static or dynamic QR codes in 13 content types (URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, email, SMS, event, crypto, and more), render styled codes with colors, gradients, and logos, list and inspect saved codes, update a dynamic code's destination after printing, and pull privacy-first scan analytics. Requires a free qr-cow account and a personal access token.

api_token.title: qr-cow API token
api_token.description: Personal access token from https://qr-cow.com/dashboard/api (free account). Required: every tool calls the qr-cow API.

tools.name: create_qrcode
tools.description: Create and SAVE a QR code in the customer's qr-cow account (it appears on their dashboard and is tracked). Pick a content type and pass the content as a string. Static codes are unlimited on every plan; dynamic codes (editable + scan analytics) have a per-plan limit (the free plan includes a few). To just render a styled image without saving, use render_styled_qrcode instead.

tools.name: render_styled_qrcode
tools.description: Render a fully STYLED QR code image (colours, dot + eye shapes, gradient, logo, error-correction) from data and a style, WITHOUT saving it to the account. Great for generating codes in bulk. Use a `preset` for a ready-made look and/or set `style` fields to override. Returns the QR as an image (png/jpg) or SVG source. Stateless: this calls POST /v1/qr/render and stores nothing.

tools.name: list_qrcodes
tools.description: List the customer's recent QR codes, newest first.

tools.name: get_qrcode
tools.description: Fetch full details for one QR code by id, including current redirect URL for dynamic codes.

tools.name: update_qrcode_destination
tools.description: Update a dynamic QR code's destination URL. The printed code doesn't change — only what scanning it leads to.

tools.name: delete_qrcode
tools.description: Soft-delete a QR code. Scans afterwards return 404.

tools.name: get_qrcode_analytics
tools.description: Fetch scan analytics for one QR code: total scans, unique scanners, breakdown by country, device, and hour of day.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Return the authenticated user's profile + plan info.
